title: EXPORT DECLARATION / DÉCLARATION D’EXPORTATION
key_sentences: I, the undersigned, declare that the particulars given in this declaration are true and complete.
I undertake to produce the goods, the transport documents and the certificates of origin at the request of the customs office.
Je soussigné déclare que les renseignements portés sur la présente déclaration sont exacts et complets.
Je m’engage à présenter les marchandises, les documents de transport et les certificats d’origine à toute réquisition du bureau de douane.

notes: Bilingual English/French customs form. Boxes 1-13 are a CSS grid of labelled form fields and boxes 16-18 are signature fields: they are a FORM, not a table, and are not in tables[]. Only the goods grid (box 14) is a table; its header cells hold two lines (English then French) joined by a space; the TOTAL label spans three columns. The red "COPY 1 ..." line and the "OFFICE STAMP" box are body decorations, neither heading nor furniture. The box titles "14 Goods / Marchandises" and "15 Declaration / Déclaration" are level-2 headings. Footer line of three spans at page bottom is furniture.
